bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” are allowed and will be searched prior to entry. Non-clear bags will undergo additional search.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Limited on-site Premier parking is available for purchase. It is recommended to plan ahead due to limited availability. Consider using rideshare options for convenience.

rideshare.note: Rideshare drop-off and pick-up is located on the corner of Franklin St. & Bagby St.

concessions.note: Currently, there is no specific information available about food and drink options at 713 Music Hall. The venue's website does not list any special offerings or highlights.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Limited storage is available for wheelchairs, canes, walkers, and other mobility devices.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in 713 Music Hall's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Will Call
ticketPickup.body: The box office is inside the main venue lobby and opens on show days one hour before the scheduled door time. Contact 713musichallinfo@livenation.com or 832-204-6920 with ticket questions.

gates.title: Entrance & Doors
gates.body: The public entrance and box office are in the main venue lobby at POST Houston. Door times are event-specific; review the event listing before arrival.
